manual_overlap.interpretation: Exclude all 1179 manual IDs as sensitivity to possible judge training/validation/test query reuse. The specific 825 training IDs are not established by this pipeline; exclusion is not proof of independent labels.

protocol.bootstrap: ordinary nonparametric paired query bootstrap with replacement; percentile 95% CI; shared resamples across contrasts
protocol.conditional_average: diagnostic only, restrict to queries with at least one positive pooled label at each K
protocol.fixed200: one RRF top10 from all three top200 lists, evaluated against each variable-K label pool
protocol.idcg: shared across every system for a query and K: sum of first min(pool positives,10) log2 discounts
protocol.label: raw_score >= -0.21871782839298248
protocol.pool: union of bm25, e5, bge rank-1-through-K document IDs per query
protocol.query_universe: union of all run query IDs; require all score query IDs in this universe
protocol.rrf: sum 1/(60+rank) over present ranks <=K; absent ranks contribute zero; top10
protocol.rrf_ties: float64 contributions sorted ascending before summing; equal scores use ascending numeric docid
protocol.run_order: explicit 1-based rank column is authoritative; do not reorder rounded retrieval scores
protocol.signflip: two-sided paired query sign-flip Monte Carlo; shared signs across contrasts; (extreme+1)/(B+1), no multiplicity correction
protocol.unjudged: outside-pool or missing-raw-score documents get zero gain; both counts reported separately
protocol.zero_idcg: retain query; every system receives exactly zero

validity_notes: These are consistency metrics against one learned judge's binary pseudoqrels, not independent human relevance or generalization estimates.
The judge checkpoint is not recovered or validated here; saved raw scores and configured threshold are the evaluated artifacts.
Changing K changes both pooled labels and variable RRF inputs; the fixed200 comparator isolates label-pool changes for one ranking.
Base-retriever top10 and their DCG stay fixed; their NDCG can fall when deeper pools increase the common IDCG.
Fixed200 RRF may return documents outside a shallow label pool; zero-gain treatment is conventional unjudged handling, not a claim that those documents are irrelevant.
Uncertainty intervals condition on the recorded runs, scores, threshold, and protocol; they do not include judge-training or labeling uncertainty.
K comparisons are paired but use different qrels. Conditional positive-query averages have K-dependent populations and are diagnostic only.
